description: For a mobile listing (no build), pass game: the state of its latest listing review and the submitted store links. Otherwise: a version's state, its server autotest report (every failed or warned check with the exact fix in its message) and reject reasons with fixes. Pass versionId, or game for its latest version. After complete_upload the state moves from testing to tested or test_failed.

game.description: The game's slug or id (list_games shows them)

versionId.description: Version id (from start_upload, get_game or get_version_status)

name: get_version_status
title: Version status and autotest report
